from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    color = min((v for v in counts if v != 0), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r,c in cells), min(c for r,c in cells)
    offsets = [(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells]
    dh, dw = max(r for r,c in offsets)+1, max(c for r,c in offsets)+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-dh+1):
        for c in range(w-dw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr,dc in offsets):
                for dr,dc in offsets: out[r+dr][c+dc] = color
    return out
